title: Diversified and Perceptible Counterfactual Examples Leveraging Expert Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2609.15609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CounterFactual Examples (CFEs) are a cornerstone of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), offering local, post hoc, and model-agnostic explanations by identifying minimal input modifications that alter a model's prediction. Yet, in order to be intelligible, these modifications must also be semantically meaningful to the explainee. This paper proposes to integrate knowledge expressed as a fuzzy linguistic vocabulary to represent the explainee's perception and interpretation of the data. The domain induced by this fuzzy vocabulary imposes structural constraints that make the features dependent, preventing the use of gradient-based optimisation methods for CFE generation, e.g., DiCE. The paper proposes a continuous data embedding in this linguistic domain and exploits it to define a variant of DiCE that allows personalisation for the explainee, named DiCEf. translated_title: 利用专家知识的多样化且可感知的反事实示例
translated_abstract: 反事实示例（CFEs）是可解释人工智能（XAI）的基石，它通过识别能够改变模型预测的最小输入修改，提供局部性、事后性和模型无关的解释。然而，为了使这些修改易于理解，它们还必须对解释对象具有语义上的意义。本文提出整合以模糊语言词汇形式表达的知识，用以表示解释对象对数据的感知和解释方式。该模糊词汇所诱导的领域施加了使特征相互依赖的结构性约束，从而无法使用基于梯度的优化方法来生成反事实示例，例如DiCE。本文提出一种在该语言领域中的连续数据嵌入方法，并利用它定义了DiCE的一个变体，该变体能够针对解释对象进行个性化，命名为DiCEf。正如在真实世界数据集上的实验结果所示，这一扩展……
tldr: 本文提出DiCEf方法，将模糊语言词汇表达的专家知识通过连续嵌入引入反事实示例生成过程，克服了特征依赖导致的梯度优化难题，实现了面向解释对象的个性化、多样化且语义可感知的模型解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DiCEf, a personalized variant of DiCE that leverages a continuous embedding of expert knowledge expressed as a fuzzy linguistic vocabulary, overcoming feature-dependency constraints to generate diversified and semantically perceptible counterfactual explanations tailored to the explainee.
